answer: By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, clawed back after a replayed submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Work waits on the hollow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
